name: Gracias
summary: Card-collecting game where you keep one card, gift one, hide one, scoring only sets of five and avoiding majority discards.
rules_text: Shuffle 108 cards (6 colors, 18 each). Over three sessions of four rounds each: each round the start player deals 2 face-up cards to every player as a start, then places in the center one triplet per player (2 face-up, 1 face-down). In clockwise order each player picks one remaining triplet, secretly looks at its face-down card and adds it face-down to his area, keeps one face-up card face-up in his area, and gifts the other face-up card face-up to any opponent. After four rounds each player reveals face-down cards. Any color where he has 5+ cards is bundled into one or more 5-stacks set aside face-down; excess stays face-up. Then for each color, whoever has the most face-up cards discards all those face-up cards; ties discard too. Players score 1 point per remaining face-up card plus 1 point per 5-stack. Scores are recorded, all cards reshuffled, and next session starts with new start player. Highest total after three sessions wins, breaking ties by best session scores.
rating_reason: Card collection by color majority; scoring by counts fits arithmetic ranking.
